prompt: Vertical candid photo, close shot of the white lid of an old chest freezer in a small British corner shop at night, the lid scratched and yellowed. A single loaf of plain white sliced bread in a clear plastic bag with a twisted end lies on the freezer lid and fills much of the frame, close and slightly from above. To its right, with a clear gap of bare lid between them, lies one small chocolate bar in a plain purple wrapper with no logo, no words and no print. In the top of the frame, behind the freezer, is the lower half of the shop's glass front door, black night outside, nothing visible through it. Two plain white price cards are taped flat and square onto the vertical white front side of the freezer, facing the camera straight on, not bent, not overlapping anything and well apart: a larger card directly below the loaf reading "£5", and a wide landscape card directly below the chocolate bar reading "10p", both handwritten in thick black marker. Cold teal fluorescent light from above, the freezer's own faint hum of a glow. Shot on cheap colour film at night, heavy grain, soft focus, muted teal-green cast, dark corners. No people, no hands, no shadows of people. Thanks.
